title: 2026 Sydney Marathon Course Cut-Offs & Redirection Points
publisher: Event & Sports Projects Australia Pty Ltd for TCS Sydney Marathon
claims: The 2026 marathon starts at 6:30am for runners and has a 130-minute start window, with the start line closed at 8:40am; no runner may cross after 8:40am.
All participants must complete the course within seven hours, equivalent to an average speed of 10 minutes per kilometre or better.
Cut-off and redirection day times are calculated from the 8:40am start-line closure; the event tail sweep pacer crosses the line at 8:40am and starts the race-pace clock then.

A runner missing an advertised cut-off or redirection time may be retired into a SAG vehicle, may walk to the finish along or outside the field of play, may be redirected to skip part of the course, or may be picked up by the SAG vehicle.
A tail control pacer and a participant tail support vehicle control the cut-off; lagging runners are warned twice before being managed.
Taking the skip option results in disqualification and the runner is not regarded as an official finisher.
The document lists the start line at 0 km closed at 8:40am as a cut-off point.

Anzac Pde at Dacey Ave is an advertised redirection point at approximately 17.8 km, skipping about 1.00 km, with a cut-off 2 hours 57 minutes after the start-line closure and an 11:37am day time if the event starts on time.
The half-way point plus 100 m at Baker St is a major redirection point at approximately 21.2 km, skipping about 4.00 km, with a cut-off 3 hours 31 minutes after closure and a 12:11pm day time.
Anzac Pde at Sturt St is a major redirection point at approximately 22.0 km, skipping about 2.00 km, with a cut-off 3 hours 40 minutes after closure and a 12:19pm day time.

Anzac Pde at the U-turn into the bus lane is a soft-skip redirection point at approximately 28.3 km where runners may retire and walk back to the finish, with a cut-off 4 hours 42 minutes after closure and a 1:22pm day time.

Moore Park at Driver Ave is a soft-skip redirection point at approximately 29.1 km where runners may walk back to the finish or exit to a SAG vehicle, with a cut-off 4 hours 50 minutes after closure and a 1:30pm day time.

The Robertson Rd gate in Centennial Park is a major redirection point at approximately 30.26 km, skipping the Centennial Park loop, with a cut-off 5 hours 02 minutes after closure and a 1:42pm day time.
The Centennial Park medical tent on Jervois Ave is a SAG pick-up point at approximately 33.4 km, with a cut-off 5 hours 34 minutes after closure and a 2:14pm day time.
Driver Ave at Moore Park Rd is a hard cut-off and SAG pick-up point at approximately 35.1 km, with a cut-off 5 hours 50 minutes after closure and a 2:32pm day time.

St Marys is a hard redirection point at approximately 37.6 km, redirecting runners to Prince Albert Rd and Macquarie St and skipping the Royal Botanic Garden, with a cut-off 6 hours 15 minutes after closure and a 2:55pm day time.
Mrs Macquarie's Rd is a redirection point at approximately 38.75 km, skipping the Mrs Macquarie's point loop, with a cut-off 6 hours 27 minutes after closure and a 3:07pm day time.
The document states that the event must reopen state and local roads and the Sydney Harbour Bridge by the advertised time, and that cut-off times will be recalculated if the start window closes late.
